Class ShapeClipper64

Namespace
ShapeEngine.ShapeClipper
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Provides reusable helpers for performing boolean clipping operations on Clipper Clipper2Lib.Path64 and Clipper2Lib.Paths64 geometry, as well as engine polygon data represented by Vector2 lists.

Remarks

This type wraps a reusable Clipper2Lib.Clipper64 instance and several internal buffers to reduce allocations across repeated clipping operations. It is intended for sequential use and does not provide thread synchronization.

ExecuteMany(Path64, Paths64, ShapeClipperClipType, Paths64)

Applies the same clipping operation sequentially to a set of clip paths against a single subject path.

public void ExecuteMany(Path64 subject, Paths64 clips, ShapeClipperClipType clipType, Paths64 solutionClosed)

Parameters

subject Path64

The initial closed subject path.

clips Paths64

The clip paths to apply one after another.

clipType ShapeClipperClipType

The clipping operation to perform for each step.

solutionClosed Paths64

The destination collection for the accumulated closed solution paths.

Remarks

Each clip path is applied to the result of the previous step. If clips is empty, this method performs no clipping.
